Hi Elena / Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning — really helpful to understand CloudGrid's ingestion volume (300M tokens/day peak), latency targets (95th < 200ms), and the data residency constraints for EU customers. Quick recap and proposed next steps below so we keep momentum: 

1) Recap of what we heard
- Primary use case: in-product generative responses for support and insights (short prompts, max context ~1,024 tokens).
- Latency requirement: keep 95th under 200ms; some spikes acceptable for long-running batch inference.
- Security: customer data must be isolated per tenant, and audit logs retained for 12 months.
- Success metric: pilot to demonstrate 30% cost reduction vs current hosted endpoints while meeting latency SLOs.

2) Proposed next steps (priority order)
- VP/CTO alignment call to confirm architectural constraints and procurement runway — ideally this week or early next.
- Technical deep-dive with our solutions engineer to walk the integration (+ KV cache approach, batching, and quantization tradeoffs).
- Draft mutual action plan + timeline so we can map checkpoints — attached a one-pager for reference.

3) Availability (calendar windows we can commit)
- Wed 17 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT (CTO intro + 20m sync + 40m Q&A)
- Thu 18 Mar, 14:00–15:30 PT (technical deep-dive full session)

If those don't work, send me two windows that work for Alex and I will lock. I can also loop in Marissa (solutions) and Ben (post-sales) on the thread to align the deep-dive scope — should I do that now?

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level timeline + milestones)

Thanks — looking forward to moving to a short pilot.

—

1) Pre-read I'm attaching a short runbook that outlines our recommended integration patterns for tenant isolation (on-prem VPC + per-tenant key wrap) and caching strategy for low-latency reads. This should answer most of Alex's architectural questions up front.

2) Agenda for Thu deep-dive (60–90m):
- 10m: Goals & success metrics (align on pilot KPIs)
- 20m: High-level architecture (isolation, networking, KMS)
- 25m: Runtime optimizations (batching, KV cache, sequence length tradeoffs)
- 15m: Integration checklist & pilot timeline (who owns what)
- 10m: Q&A/admin items (SLA, logs, support model)

3) Quick ask: Can CloudGrid share a small sample of typical prompt lengths and token distribution (no PII) before Thu so we can tune the demo? If sending is difficult, a short breakdown in the reply is fine.
